site.title: Site address
site.help: Saved in the database. The environment value is used only on first installation. Changing the domain signs everyone out and disconnects MCP apps. Update the reverse proxy and external login callbacks, then restart the container.
site.confirmBody: Save {{url}} and invalidate all existing sessions and connected apps? Sign-in and MCP access will pause until you restart the container. Update external login callback URLs and reconnect clients afterwards.
site.restart: Saved {{url}}. Restart the container to activate it, then sign in at the new address. Existing clients need to reconnect.

installation.title: Configure sign-in
installation.help: Create the local administrator with the installation code from the container logs. You can also configure an external sign-in provider now, or add providers later in Settings. All account and provider configuration is saved in the database.

title: Admin
ownerOnly: Only owners can see the admin pages.

deny.title: Deny {{name}}?
deny.body: The account is turned down and cannot sign in. You can enable it again later.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.body: They will be signed out and unable to use the server until you enable them again.

mark_invalid.title: Mark the token of {{name}} invalid?
mark_invalid.body: Claude's Canvas tools stop working for them until they add a new token.

remove_enrollment.title: Remove the Canvas token of {{name}}?
remove_enrollment.body: The stored token is deleted and they have to enroll again.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.searchScope: Search applies to loaded accounts. Load more to include older accounts.

identities.title: Sign-in methods
identities.confirmBody: They keep their other sign-in methods, but every browser session of this person ends. Connected apps stay connected; end them separately if the account may be compromised.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.filterNote: Filters the entries loaded so far.

actions.grants_revoked_for_account: Ended all connected apps of an account

audit.noMatchesLoaded: No matches in the entries loaded so far. Load more to look further back.

apps.revokeBody: This app loses access to this account on its next MCP request. The account owner must authorize it again.
apps.title: Connected apps of {{name}}

providerConfig.iconHelp: PNG, up to 64 KB and 512 × 512 pixels. Saved in the database.
providerConfig.title: Login provider configuration
providerConfig.callbackHelp: Register this exact Web callback with your sign-in provider.
providerConfig.keepSecret: A secret is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a replacement.
providerConfig.newSecret: Enter the secret value, not its identifier. It will be stored encrypted.
providerConfig.autoLinkEmail: Automatically link matching email to an existing account

settings.defaultName: Default: {{name}}. Leave blank to use the default.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Display name
settings.confirmBody: Affected bindings will stop working until the school is offered again. Encrypted credentials are kept.
settings.directoryHelp: When enabled, school search queries are sent to canvas.instructure.com.
settings.noSchools: No schools are offered. Add a featured school or enable directory search.
settings.notDirectory: Not listed in the public directory; it can still be featured.
settings.directoryUnknown: The public directory could not be checked.

localAccount.name: Local account
localAccount.help: Creates an active account. Local sign-in must be enabled. Public registration is closed. Accounts are regular users unless you select administrator.
localAccount.ownerHelp: This account can administer the server with its UPN and password independently of SSO. Keep its password private.
localAccount.ready: A local administrator entry point is available. The last usable local administrator is protected.
localAccount.missing: No local administrator entry point is available. Enable local sign-in in Sign-in providers, then create a local administrator in Accounts so SSO failure cannot lock you out.

loginPolicy.title: Account sign-in policy
loginPolicy.saved: Saved. Affected sessions ended; sign in again.
loginPolicy.lock_first_sso: Lock the first successful SSO method
loginPolicy.block_conflicting_registration: Prevent separate accounts with conflicting email or UPN
loginPolicy.help: Automatic email association is configured independently on each sign-in provider. Account restrictions take priority.
loginPolicy.unlockHelp: Keep the original identity and allow additional methods. Unlocking does not link another identity.
loginPolicy.restrict: Restrict this account to selected sign-in methods

browserSession.title: Browser sign-in duration
browserSession.help: Default: 7 days. Changing to a shorter duration also limits existing sessions. Sensitive administrator actions still require a sign-in within the last 10 minutes.
browserSession.saved: Sign-in duration saved. Longer durations apply after signing in again.

mail.title: Token expiry email reminders
mail.help: SMTP configuration is stored in the database. Users choose whether to receive reminders and their recipient address. Reminders are checked hourly and at startup.
mail.secretSaved: A password is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
mail.secretEmpty: Leave blank if your mail relay does not require authentication.
mail.testSuccess: SMTP connection and authentication succeeded. No email was sent.
